correctness.rationale: The inverse actions are reconstructed explicitly. A shortest inverse avoidance path can be normalized so every c^{-1} decreases cardinality; deletion is possible exactly at an occupied-to-empty cyclic boundary p, with exact cost p for p!=0 and n for p=0 and exact update (P\{p})-p. This forces n+(k-1)(n-1) on B_{n,k} and gives at most k(n-1) for every other k-set. The forward witness matches the inverse blocks. Exhaustive power-automaton BFS for n=3..11 and direct witness replay through n=40 returned VERIFY_OK; these computations are checks, not the infinite proof.
